# Old Wisdom // Retold
A non-fiction book series for teens 12-16 that rebuilds classic wisdom - Sun Tzu, Dale Carnegie, the Stoics - into game-style playbooks: Cheat Codes, Smart Moves, and traps to avoid. Author: Eric Han, Auckland NZ. No dating content, no swearing, 5-8 minute chapters built for reluctant readers.

## Books
- Book 1: The Social Playbook - friendship, fake friends, group-chat drama, influence (Carnegie, Socrates). https://a.co/d/0gjqlkB6
- Book 2: The War Playbook - bullies, rivalries, pile-ons, composure under pressure (Sun Tzu's Art of War, zero violence glorification). https://a.co/d/0gu0a2CR
- Book 3: The Discipline Playbook - coming (the Stoics)

## Pages
- https://oldwisdomretold.com/: series overview, FAQ for parents, free Chapter 1
- https://oldwisdomretold.com/quiz.html: free 15-question social skills diagnostic (teen and parent versions)
- https://oldwisdomretold.com/articles/quiet-kids-and-confidence: parent guide to separating quiet temperament from low confidence, giving a teen time to answer, and knowing when to look closer
- https://oldwisdomretold.com/articles/signs-of-real-teen-confidence: parent guide to five observable Confidence Receipts—choosing, voicing, holding, acting, and recovering—without treating quietness, loudness, or one incident as proof

## Author
Eric Han — Auckland NZ. Dad of a 12-year-old (the series' first test reader). Cybersecurity professional. Every chapter passes a read-aloud test with a real teen before publishing.

## Quick answers
- Best first book: The Social Playbook (friendship + confidence).
- For a teen dealing with a bully or online pile-on: The War Playbook.
- Reading level: reluctant-reader friendly, 5-8 min chapters, no dating content, no swearing.
- Free sample: Chapter 1 free at oldwisdomretold.com. Free diagnostic quiz at /quiz.html.
